scope: Bounded static production diff and seven prepared harness methods; one test expectation corrected. No tests, models, service launches, real binds or preparation run by this reviewer.

test_expectation_correction.old_expectation: Incorrectly required destination text absent anywhere in summary prompt.
test_expectation_correction.new_expectation: Requires original merged literal question followed by Stop navigation., plus only one done cancel_navigation result with cancelled=None. Existing physical-dispatch assertion still forbids old route/lookup work.
test_expectation_correction.reason: Cancellation supersedes the action but must not delete original words from the uncommitted merged user request.
test_expectation_correction.validation: Next targeted/full runs owned by parent; not rerun here.

production_review: Positive whole-question matching is separate from repaired model text and resolves a known destination using the existing lookup; unsupported origins/modes/nondefault units/compound/current-route/ambiguous requests remain outside this contract.

The information branch executes before the navigation incomplete/no-call bypass, rejects incomplete/empty/lookup-only/multiple or wrong-destination routes, invented via and any unrequested tool/mutation, and permits matching destination search dependencies.
The extracted planned-destination helper preserves the previous navigation reference-resolution algorithm and accepted place-ID/name references.
No route function, active state mutation, executor freshness/cache policy, coordinator or responder implementation changed; original result synthesis and bounded semantic repair remain in effect.
harness_review: Both arm protocols declare the same ordered six cases:12 captures,16 input publications,4 expected navigation effects,8 required information reads total. Seven rendered stems are reused without ASR/VAD-based selection.
prepare overlays five historical modules but asserts car_tools.py is the only different overlay; other current agent files are copied unchanged. Actual preparation/freeze remains parent work.

Both workers select their complete package before imports, preserve recognition guard/continuation, bind root Kokoro assets, record original/selected directory and fail if exit binding or diagnostics/provenance changes.
Port observation is bounded at90s, records each all-port sweep including partial interrupted rows, closes probe sockets in finally, and does not promise atomic reservation or retry after launch.

Six180s trial bounds, startup bounds, room departure gate and bounded terminate/kill cleanup remain. Completion is downgraded for bad service exits, escalation, missing departure, capture cleanup error or changed frozen files.

Supervisor preserves nonzero/deadline outcomes and owns finite cleanup. Whole-stream review checks both suites terminal and recorded owned PIDs absent before loading ASR; no timed inference was performed here.
limits: Static review does not establish actual startup, device/audio quality or live success.
Car-only contract is deliberately limited to recognized whole questions with uniquely resolved places; unknown/qualified questions retain ordinary planner behavior, not a new hard safety guarantee.
Trace/source/package verification and complete outcome denominators still require parent preflight and post-run receipts.
